summary: Master the essentials of Occupational Safety and Health Regulations with our training course. Protect your workforce and meet industry standards effectively.
lede: Occupational health and safety courses cover how to turn workplace requirements into practical safety systems. They are for safety, compliance and operations professionals who need to identify hazards, assess risks and strengthen workplace safety practices. Learners practice job hazard analysis, selecting controls, investigating incidents with root-cause methods, planning emergency procedures and tracking performance measures such as LTIR and DART.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must translate OSH regulations into actionable safety systems and measurable compliance outcomes. HSE Officer:
audience: Conduct daily hazard assessments and risk audits
Compliance Coordinator: navigate OSHA requirements and prepare
Operations Supervisor: enforce Hierarchy of Controls
Risk Analyst: calculate LTIR/DART metrics and build
EHS Specialist: conduct Job Hazard Analyses
Contractor Safety Representative: manage stakeholder compliance
Quality & Safety Auditor: execute compliance checklists
modules: Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis
Safety Performance Measurement and Digital Dashboards
Safety Strategy Integration and Stakeholder Reporting
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic workplace experience in safety, operations, or compliance is beneficial. Participants should bring examples of current safety challenges from their work environment (e.g., recent incidents, audit findings, or hazard reports) for practical application during exercises.
